body.name: Total full-covariance full-data Hoeffding interval
body.construction:
Fix \(\alpha_{\mathrm{hist}}=\alpha_{\mathrm{evt}}=\alpha_{\mathrm{don}}=\alpha/3\), and use the donor folds, projected complementary-fold centers, normalized-shape bandwidth selector, and full-data raw local-polynomial fits in \texttt{def:feasible-estimator}.  On every successful fit define
\[
G_{sk}=\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{n_s}w_{stk}b_r(u_{stk})b_r(u_{stk})^{\top},
\qquad
a_{stik}=e_0^{\top}G_{sk}^{-1}w_{stk}b_r(u_{stk}),
\]
\[
\bar a_{sti}=K_D^{-1}\sum_{k=1}^{K_D}a_{stik},
\qquad
\widehat m_s=\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{n_s}\bar a_{sti}Q_{sti}.
\]
Set
\[
A_L=C_{r,d}L\sum_{s=1}^{S}\frac{\pi_s}{K_D}
\sum_{k=1}^{K_D}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{n_s}
|a_{stik}|\,\|X_{st}-\widetilde z_{sk}\|_2^{\lambda},
\]
\[
R_{\mathrm{hist}}
=B\left\{\frac12\log\!\left(\frac{2}{\alpha_{\mathrm{hist}}}\right)
\sum_{s=1}^{S}\sum_{i=1}^{n_s}
\left[\pi_s\sum_{t=1}^{T}|\bar a_{sti}|\right]^2\right\}^{1/2},
\]
\[
R_{\mathrm{evt}}
=B\left\{\frac12\log\!\left(\frac{2}{\alpha_{\mathrm{evt}}}\right)
\sum_{s=1}^{S}\frac{\pi_s^2}{n_s}\right\}^{1/2}.
\]
For donor fold \(k\) with complementary size \(m_k\), put \(D=Sd\), \(Y_j=\Sigma^{-1/2}(Z_j-z_0)\),
\[
M_4(m_k)=\frac{B}{m_k}+\left(1-\frac1{m_k}\right)(D^2+2D),
\quad
q_k=\left\{\frac{K_DM_4(m_k)}{\alpha_{\mathrm{don}}}\right\}^{1/4},
\]
\[
\delta_k=\sqrt{\frac{C_\Sigma}{c_\Sigma}}\frac{q_k}{\sqrt{m_k}},
\qquad
A_{\mathrm{don}}=\frac{C_{\mathrm{mod}}}{K_D}\sum_{k=1}^{K_D}\delta_k^\kappa.
\]
On the good sample set
\[
H_\alpha=R_{\mathrm{hist}}+R_{\mathrm{evt}}+A_L+A_{\mathrm{don}},
\qquad
C_\alpha=[-B,B]\cap[\widehat\tau-H_\alpha,\widehat\tau+H_\alpha].
\]
The bad-sample event is the union of: an empty donor complement; failure of a selected Gram matrix under the normalized-shape rule; nonfiniteness of any required weight or radius; undefined spectral clipping; and \(\max_k\delta_k>\delta_0\).  On that event set \(C_\alpha=[-B,B]\).
